# Break the Block

> Break the Block: Twelve Lessons for Citizen-Led Change from Bengaluru's Rail Campaign by Sathya Sankaran. ISBN: 979-8-90269-374-1. A non-fiction book documenting how five ordinary citizens refused to accept 'no' for ten years and brought commuter rail to India's most traffic-congested city. Available in hardcover (₹599/$29.99), paperback (₹349/$19.99), and eBook (₹199/$4.99). Published February 2026.

The book extracts 12 Key Lessons, 34 Chapter Insights, and 83 Extended Takeaways from a decade-long citizen campaign (2009–2020) to bring suburban rail to Bengaluru (Bangalore), India. It serves as both a narrative and a practical field guide for civic activism, navigating bureaucracy, building coalitions, and changing governance systems.

## About the Author

Sathya Sankaran is a civic activist, technology professional, urban mobility advocate, and podcast host based in Bengaluru. He is a founding member of the Namma Railu (Our Train) campaign and host of The OoruLabs Podcast.
